name: tew-tracker
description: Save file viewer for Total Extreme Wrestling 9

scripts.dev:react: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }" 2>nul & vite --open
scripts.dev:python: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8567 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }" 2>nul & cd python && py -3.14 -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8567
scripts.build:python: node scripts/kill-backend.js && py -3.14 -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --onedir --distpath dist-python --workpath build-python --paths python --name main python/main.py
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:react && npm run build:python && electron-builder --win
scripts.release: npm run build:react && npm run build:python && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.build: npm run gen:types && npm run build:react
